name: Rising Leaders Program
org: Paul H. O'Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A program of several days on the IU campus. O'Neill teachers lead classes on leading, public policy and community work. You meet IU students and learn about majors and careers.
who_can_apply: High school students finishing junior year with a GPA of at least 3.0 out of 4.0. You like leading and community work. Clubs and your application essays count too.
pay_detail: Free if accepted. You pay your own travel to Bloomington and spending money. Travel scholarships may be available.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was March 1 and decisions went out by March 25. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online with an application and essays. Check the box on the form if you want a travel scholarship. Questions: iurlp@iu.edu.
notes: Check the page in the fall for 2027 dates. The page does not say if housing is on campus.
